title: fix(richtext-lexical)!: upgrade lexical to 0.52.0 and tsx to 4.23.15
body:
_Written with AI_

Upgrades `lexical` and every installed `@lexical/*` package from `0.50.0` to `0.52.0` for Payload 4.x (`main`), and pinned `tsx` dependencies from `4.22.4` to `4.23.15`. Removes the native-loader workaround no longer needed with the new tsx version.

Also fixes duplicate image uploads triggered by repeated node transforms in Lexical 0.52. CI fixes update the keyboard-navigation expectation and correct an existing auth-test parameter error that blocked integration tests.

Fixes #17757

3.x counterpart: #18398.

## Why this fixes the CLI failure

With Payload 3.90.1 on Node 22.22.0, importing a config that included `lexicalEditor()` could leave CLI startup pending before the config or target script was evaluated. The process then exited 0 with no output and left a pending PostgreSQL migration unapplied. Previously, Payload started the CLI with `void start()`, and an unresolved promise alone does not keep Node's event loop alive.

Lexical 0.50's Node entry points select their build with top-level `await import(...)`, which is probably what caused it. Lexical has shipped ESM-only packages since **0.51**, using static imports instead of those asynchronous Node wrappers. Upgrading to 0.52 fixes this issue.

Also removes the `module.registerHooks = undefined` workaround for #16949. tsx 4.23.15 [excludes bare built-ins from namespace inheritance](https://github.com/privatenumber/tsx/commit/38e158857e50bca311be7c232a5057e5a2e5347a), following its [Node 24 `tsImport` bridge fix](https://github.com/privatenumber/tsx/commit/6e5236b065738d3687a06396d064774cfede390f).

## CLI exit codes

CLI startup is now awaited at the top level in all three loader paths: tsx, SWC, and disabled transpilation. If an import never settles and Node runs out of work, Node reports an unsettled top-level await and exits 13. Successful commands still exit 0, and command-specific failure codes are preserved.

## Breaking changes

Rich-text data keeps its existing format. No database migration is needed. Payload's built-in features have been updated, but your own TypeScript code or custom features may need changes:

- **Generic types:** `SerializedEditorState<T>`, `SerializedElementNode<T>`, and `SerializedRootNode<T>` no longer accept `<T>`. Remove it if the base node type is enough, or use Payload's `TypedEditorState<T>` for documents with your own node types. Without `<T>`, children are still `SerializedLexicalNode[]`.
- **Export types:** `ReturnType<Node['exportJSON']>` can now make fields such as `version` and `url` optional. Use the node's explicit serialized type, such as `SerializedLinkNode`, when you need the full format. Normal `node.exportJSON()` calls still return full JSON.
- **Selection listeners:** `SELECTION_CHANGE_COMMAND` now fires before the DOM is updated. If your custom listener reads the DOM, defer that work with `$onUpdate(() => editor.read('latest', callback))`.
- **Saved node references:** If you keep a node reference across an editor update, call `node.getLatest().exportJSON()` to export its current values.

The type changes also affect imports through `@payloadcms/richtext-lexical/lexical` and its subpaths. Payload's `TypedEditorState<T>` and its own serialized node types keep their generic APIs for this upgrade.

Keep importing Lexical through Payload's re-exports; do not install a separate Lexical version. See the [custom feature documentation](https://payloadcms.com/docs/rich-text/custom-features). The table below also lists removed APIs that may affect custom features. `LexicalComposer` is deprecated but still available.

## Breaking changes and Payload migrations

Reviewed [0.51.0](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/releases/tag/v0.51.0) and [0.52.0](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/releases/tag/v0.52.0), including the serialization declarations. **Yes** means Payload code needed adaptation; **No** means no Payload migration was required.

| Release | Breaking change | Required migration in Payload | Changes made |
| ------- | --------------- | ----------------------------- | ------------ |
| 0.51 | [npm packages are ESM only](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/pull/9127); older CommonJS consumers must use dynamic imports. | No | Payload already uses ESM. This removes the asynchronous Lexical wrapper involved in the CLI reproducer. |
| 0.51 | [Serialization schemas and compact export](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/pull/8602) add `exportJSON` overloads and remove the `SerializedEditorState`, `SerializedElementNode`, and `SerializedRootNode` generics. `ReturnType` can now infer compact, partial JSON. | Yes | Infer the full-format overload for node hooks, validation and population while preserving custom nodes' literal `type` discriminants. Update `hasText` to the non-generic editor-state type.  |
| 0.51 | [`exportJSON` can serialize a retained instance without calling `getLatest()`](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/pull/8602). | No | Audited Payload's clipboard and Markdown call sites: they serialize nodes obtained from the current selection/tree, without an intervening mutation. Custom callers holding stale references should use `node.getLatest().exportJSON()`. |
| 0.51 | [Deprecated Prism re-exports are removed from `@lexical/code`](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/pull/9141). | No | Payload does not consume the removed exports. |
| 0.52 | [`SELECTION_CHANGE_COMMAND` runs before DOM reconciliation](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/pull/9219), including node and table selections. | Yes | Defer link popup, inline toolbar and decorator DOM work with `$onUpdate` and `editor.read('latest', ...)`. Keep nested decorator updates with their own editor. The table menu already defers DOM reads. |
| 0.52 | [Default HTML export honors `DOMRenderExtension` `$createDOM` overrides](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/pull/9231). | No | Payload does not configure these extension overrides; existing converter tests pass. |
| 0.52 | [`LexicalNode.getCommonAncestor` is removed](https://github.com/facebook/lexical/pull/9238). | No | No Payload call sites. Custom consumers can use `$getCommonAncestor`, accounting for its different handling of non-element nodes. |

React package entry points were compared against 0.50.0; no Payload proxy exports need adding or removing.

## Previous Lexical upgrades

- [#18149](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/pull/18149) — 0.48.0 → 0.50.0
- [#17554](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/pull/17554) — 0.45.0 → 0.48.0
- [#17064](https://github.com/payloadcms/payload/pull/17064) — 0.41.0 → 0.45.0

+describe('CLI exit codes', () => {
+  let testDir: string
+
+  beforeEach(async () => {
+    testDir = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), 'payload-cli-exit-'))
+
+    const runCommandURL = pathToFileURL(
+      path.resolve(cliDirectory, '../../dist/cli/commands/run.js'),
+    ).href
+
+    await writeFile(
+      path.join(testDir, 'payload.config.mjs'),
+      `import { createRunCommand } from ${JSON.stringify(runCommandURL)}
+export default { cli: { commands: { run: createRunCommand } } }
+`,
+    )
+  })
+
+  afterEach(async () => {
+    await rm(testDir, { force: true, recursive: true })
+  })
+
+  it.each([
+    { exitCode: 0, source: 'await Promise.resolve()', state: 'completes' },
+    { exitCode: 13, source: 'await new Promise(() => {})', state: 'remains pending' },
+    { exitCode: 1, source: "throw new Error('EXPECTED_FAILURE')", state: 'throws' },
+    { exitCode: 7, source: 'process.exitCode = 7', state: 'sets a custom exit code' },
+  ])('should exit with code $exitCode when the script $state', async ({ exitCode, source }) => {
+    const scriptPath = path.join(testDir, 'script.mjs')
+
+    await writeFile(scriptPath, `console.log('SCRIPT_STARTED')\n${source}\n`)
+
+    const result = spawnSync(
+      process.execPath,
+      [path.resolve(cliDirectory, '../../bin.js'), 'run', scriptPath],
+      {
+        cwd: testDir,
+        encoding: 'utf8',
+        env: { ...process.env, PAYLOAD_CONFIG_PATH: path.join(testDir, 'payload.config.mjs') },
+        timeout: 10_000,
+      },
+    )
+
+    expect(result.error).toBeUndefined()
+    expect(result.signal).toBeNull()
+    expect(result.stdout).toContain('SCRIPT_STARTED')
+    expect(result.status).toBe(exitCode)
+  })
+})
+
